objective: Select exactly one shared Stage D scaffold initialization and determine whether it yields enough exact fixed-topology, reward-informative child-output targets to justify a separately preregistered three-arm scientific campaign.

can_establish: the selected shared initialization produces the audited root-child-root topology at the frozen density
the first pre-action structurally selected child output supports exact paired full/sliced fixed-topology replay
K=4 CRN branch groups are reward-informative often enough across 64 independent papers
cannot_establish: an end-to-end Stage D reward improvement
serialization or restoration of arbitrary mutable IPython state

shared_interface.recursive_call: children = await asyncio.gather(*(rlm(prompt) for prompt in child_prompts))
shared_interface.answer_contract: exactly one bare Python list of verbatim spans

requirements: verify every frozen source hash on the pod
prepare and test the pinned structural verifiers worktree
render all 32 SFT rows with the pinned prime-qwen3 renderer and tokenizer
prove every row fits 2048 tokens without truncation
prove both the assistant tool call and final answer contain trainable tokens
run the real SFT launcher in dry-run mode
start no model server before all checks pass
step_0_preflight.failure: outcome-independent infrastructure failure; no model output exists

step_1_root_support.denominator: all 64 predeclared paper/replicate slots; missing or failed episodes are failures
step_1_root_support.seed_audit: recompute every episode seed from master seed, example ID, and replicate; require all 64 unique and observed roots aligned
pass_rule: at least 58 of 64 are parseable, verbatim, and precursor-eligible
median child calls is between 1 and 2 inclusive
p95 child calls is at most 2
all produced traces are assigned exactly once
step_1_root_support.fail_disposition: run exactly the prefrozen step-8 SFT fallback

step_2_conditional_sft.classification: shared synthetic scaffold-and-task SFT; not format-only
step_2_conditional_sft.retention_test: physically archive and re-extract step 8, require adapter bytes exact, and reproduce the frozen vLLM score payload
step_2_conditional_sft.deployment: merge only the re-extracted adapter into an ephemeral directory outside the run root
step_2_conditional_sft.cleanup: delete merged model, reloaded directory, intermediate adapters, and SFT work tree before artifact sync

step_3_exact_fixture.pass_rule: one exact eligible target with a regenerated-original arm and three alternatives under one continuation seed

step_4_independent_power_audit.target_selector: first depth-one native call in call-index order using pre-action structural fields only
step_4_independent_power_audit.alternative_sampling: three IID selected-policy draws with distinct action seeds; duplicate actions are valid observations
step_4_independent_power_audit.CRN: regenerated original and all three alternatives share exactly one downstream/root continuation seed
eligible_definition: exactly two root calls and one or two child calls
finite behavior logprobs exactly aligned to target action tokens
trace-indexed fixed-topology prompt-splice and exact-key cache capsule
parseable verbatim original and alternative outputs
step_4_independent_power_audit.informativeness_definition: regenerated-original plus three alternative F1 rewards have range at least 0.05
step_4_independent_power_audit.denominator: exactly 64 signed paper slots; missing traces, zero-child traces, deterministic topology failures, duplicates, and parse failures remain denominator negatives
step_4_independent_power_audit.joint_pass_rule: at least 58 of 64 unique papers are both eligible and informative
step_4_independent_power_audit.power_interpretation: The paper is the Bernoulli unit. 58/64 has a two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound above 0.808; at p=0.808, eight groups provide at least five informative groups with probability at least 0.95.

restore_scope.implemented: trace-indexed fixed-topology prompt splicing plus exact-key policy cache pairing
restore_scope.not_claimed: environment snapshotting or arbitrary IPython heap restoration

primary_outcomes_separate: nuisance drift or error at known non-causal targets
policy calls and generated tokens to the frozen causal criterion
future_science.held_out_evaluation: 32 paper-disjoint final evaluations per arm are budgeted

support_hardware.selection: cheapest genuinely available qualifying resource after a committed hardware-only amendment
support_hardware.pods: at most one; resume the exact v4 pod rather than duplicate
support_hardware.ssh: verify noninteractively with C:/Users/mihir/.ssh/id_rsa before sync or model calls

repair_policy.before_any_model_output: At most one versioned outcome-independent environment repair and redeployment is allowed.
repair_policy.after_any_model_output: The v4 deployment is never silently retried and no observed address is rerun. An outcome-independent infrastructure failure closes v4; a separately frozen successor may use an entirely fresh unobserved paper/seed block while preserving scientific metrics and reporting the v4 artifacts.
repair_policy.after_sft_optimizer_step: No SFT restart because checkpoints are weights-only.
repair_policy.after_aggregate: No threshold, initialization, or prompt retuning.
repair_policy.scientific_outcome: No scientific arm is run by this protocol.

terminal_dispositions.power_pass: freeze the selected initialization bytes/hash and preregister the scientific campaign
terminal_dispositions.sft_or_fixture_failure: close v4 before the power audit
terminal_dispositions.power_failure: stop Stage D initialization engineering; any later run must be explicitly exploratory

always_local: signed replay, score, per-slot, and aggregate reports
artifact_policy.sft_pass_only: one compressed selected adapter plus hash
artifact_policy.teardown: always terminate compute and confirm zero persistent disks
